Hey Hana,

If you're reading this, it means you typed in the secret code (which is already a 10/10 in my book 🫶). I wanted to make something small, cute, and forever — just like how I feel about you.

You make ordinary days feel like soft pink Sundays. You make my heart do the Hello Kitty dance, and I wouldn't trade you for a thousand cute plushies.

Thank you for being my person, my home, my favorite notification, my late-night laugh, and my forever partner in this crazy little love story of ours.

I love you more than words (and more than all the Sanrio characters combined, and that's a LOT 💗).

— Forever yours, Tee 💕
